title: Level 0.5 — Chương 20: Cái Giá Được Gọi Đúng Tên
requiredFacts: Tùng clearly reaffirms consent only for the use of his own Tinh Hồn; Hà explicitly refuses; Lục Trầm explicitly refuses.
Tùng dies permanently after Cao Minh takes his Tinh Hồn.
Hà dies permanently after Cao Minh takes her Tinh Hồn despite her explicit refusal.
Cao Minh uses both Tinh Hồn on Lục Trầm despite her refusal; the result is only temporary stabilization, not a full recovery.
The travelling party after this chapter is Cao Minh and Lục Trầm only.
The chapter ends at a threshold toward the next region without crossing or naming it in-world.
forbiddenClaims: Do not rewrite the event as all three people consenting.
Do not revive Hà or Tùng.
Do not claim Lục Trầm is fully healed or that Tịch Quang and her right hand have fully recovered.
Do not make Tâm Ma the controller or excuse for Cao Minh's decision.
Do not perform or name a Level 0.5 -> Level 0.7 transition in Story metadata; LevelCore owns the destination.
